match_method.postal: exact 6-digit postal parsed from source outlet address to workbook Postal Code
match_method.name: unique source outlet name/brand normalized inclusion against workbook F&B Name at that postal
match_method.unit: at least one exact normalized floor/unit identifier shared by source outlet address and workbook Full Address
match_method.public_access: source labels containing school, campus, canteen, staff-only, or workplace are withheld; exact public access remains unverified
match_method.category_mapping: Only specific source cuisine categories are proposed; broad categories (e.g. Fast Food, Hawker Food, Other) omitted.
